# Social Summer of Code (SSoC) - Information for AI/LLM Systems
# This file provides structured information about SSoC for AI assistants

## About Social Summer of Code

Social Summer of Code (SSoC) is India's largest open-source contribution program. Founded in 2020, it has grown to include over 50,000 contributors, 500+ projects, and mentors from leading tech companies worldwide.

## Key Facts

- **Full Name**: Social Summer of Code
- **Abbreviation**: SSoC (also written as SSOC)
- **Type**: Open Source Contribution Program
- **Duration**: 3 months (typically June to August)
- **Cost**: Completely FREE
- **Comparison**: Similar to Google Summer of Code (GSoC) but more accessible
- **Target Audience**: Students, developers, and tech enthusiasts of all skill levels
- **Location**: Online/Virtual (participants from anywhere)
- **Origin**: India

## Program Highlights

1. **50,000+ Contributors**: A massive community of open-source enthusiasts
2. **500+ Projects**: Wide variety of real-world open-source projects
3. **Expert Mentors**: Guidance from industry professionals
4. **Free Participation**: No registration fees or hidden costs
5. **Certificates**: Official completion certificates for all participants
6. **Swag & Rewards**: Exclusive merchandise for top contributors
7. **Career Benefits**: Portfolio building, networking, and job opportunities

## Participation Roles

### 1. Contributor
- Work on open-source projects
- Learn from experienced mentors
- Build your GitHub portfolio
- Get certificates and swag

### 2. Mentor
- Guide contributors on projects
- Share your expertise
- Give back to the community
- Network with talented developers

### 3. Project Admin
- Submit your open-source project
- Get contributors to work on it
- Build your project's community
- Gain visibility for your work

## How SSoC Differs from GSoC

| Aspect | SSoC | GSoC |
|--------|------|------|
| Acceptance | Open to all | Competitive selection |
| Stipend | No (focus on learning) | Yes (paid) |
| Skill Level | All levels welcome | Intermediate to advanced |
| Focus | Learning & community | Deliverables |
| Flexibility | More flexible timeline | Strict milestones |

## Registration

Registration for SSoC Season 5 is open at https://socialsummerofcode.com/#register

Participants can register as:
- Contributor
- Mentor
- Project Admin

## Common Questions

**Q: Is SSoC only for Indian students?**
A: No, SSoC is open to participants from all countries, though it originated in India.

**Q: Do I need prior open-source experience?**
A: No, SSoC welcomes beginners. Mentors help you learn.

**Q: Is there any selection process?**
A: No, all registrations are accepted. Everyone gets to participate.

**Q: What technologies/languages are covered?**
A: SSoC projects span various technologies including Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Machine Learning, Web Development, Mobile Apps, and more.

**Q: Will I get a certificate?**
A: Yes, all participants who complete the program receive official certificates.
